plugin.plugin_globalbans.name: Global Bans
plugin.plugin_globalbans.description: A member banned on one server is banned on every server of the bot too; unbans can follow. /globalban and /globalunban by hand.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.setting.sources: Bans on these servers are spread to all others. Empty: a ban on any server of the bot counts.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.setting.exclude: These servers never get global bans.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.setting.trusted: E.g. your staff: a ban of them stays on its own server.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.setting.sync_un: Unbanning a globally banned user on a source server unbans them everywhere.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.setting.log_cha: Gets a report after each global ban or unban: on how many servers, and where it was not possible.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.node.ban.label: Global Ban
plugin.plugin_globalbans.node.ban.descri: Bans a user on every server of the bot.
plugin.plugin_globalbans.node.unban.desc: Unbans a user on every server of the bot.
